name: Maintain boundaries during emotional support
short_description: Maintain boundaries during emotional support once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can maintain boundaries during emotional support in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Maintain boundaries during emotional support means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Maintain boundaries during emotional support in a fresh real-life scenario.
